name: Wally – AI-Powered Conversational Search for WordPress
author: AIDev

sections.description:
Wally is an AI-powered conversational search tool for your WordPress site that enables visitors to search your site content through natural conversation. With Wally, you can provide instant, accurate answers to visitor questions based on your website content.

Note: This plugin requires a Wally API key to function. You can sign up for a free account at trywally.ai.

Key Features

  • AI-Powered Conversational Search: Add a modern, customizable search widget to your WordPress site
  • Content Indexing: Automatically index your WordPress content with Wally’s AI system
  • Easy Setup: Connect your site in minutes with a simple API key
  • Customizable Appearance: Adjust the search widget to match your site’s design
  • Auto-Sync Option: Keep your search tool up-to-date with your latest content

How It Works

  1. Install and activate the Wally plugin
  2. Sign up for a Wally account at trywally.ai and get your API key
  3. Enter your API key in the Wally settings page
  4. Index your content with Wally
  5. Enable the search widget
  6. Your visitors can now search your content through conversation!

Privacy and Data Handling

Wally connects to our service to provide AI-powered conversational search functionality. Here’s what you should know about data handling:

  • Content Indexing: When you index content, your posts, pages, and attached PDFs are sent to our service to train the search assistant.
  • Search Data: Visitor search conversations are processed by our service to generate responses.
  • WordPress Metadata: Basic site information (site name, URL, admin email) is shared with our service for account management.
  • User Consent: The search widget is opt-in for your visitors – they choose when to interact with it.

For more information, please see our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.

External services

Wally connects to our service at trywally.ai to provide AI-powered conversational search functionality for your website visitors.

The plugin connects to the following external services:
1. Wally API Service (https://www.trywally.ai): This service processes your website content and provides AI conversational search functionality.
– When indexing content, your posts, pages, and PDF attachments are sent to this service.
– When visitors use the search widget, their search messages are sent to this service to generate responses.
– Basic site information (name, URL, admin email) is sent for account management purposes.
– This service is needed for the core functionality of the plugin to work.
– Terms of Service: https://www.trywally.ai/terms
– Privacy Policy: https://www.trywally.ai/privacy

Privacy Policy

Wally connects to our service at trywally.ai to provide AI-powered conversational search functionality for your website visitors.

The plugin collects and processes the following data:

  1. Website Content: Your posts, pages, and PDF attachments are sent to our service when you index content.
  2. Site Information: Basic site information (name, URL, description, admin email, WordPress version) is shared for account management.
  3. Search Conversations: Visitor search conversations are processed by our service to generate responses.

All data is transmitted securely using HTTPS. For complete details on how we handle data, please see our Privacy Policy.

This plugin uses cookies or local storage for search session management. Visitors who use the search widget implicitly consent to this storage.

If you disable or remove this plugin, no new data will be sent to our service, but you may need to delete existing data through your Wally dashboard.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the wally folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to the Wally settings page in your WordPress admin
  4. Sign up for a Wally account at trywally.ai if you haven’t already
  5. Enter your API key in the settings page and click “Verify Key”
  6. Once verified, click “Index Content Now” to send your content to Wally
  7. Enable the search widget using the toggle switch
  8. The search widget will now appear on your site!
sections.faq:
Do I need an account to use Wally?

Yes, you need to create an account at trywally.ai to get an API key, which is required for the plugin to function.

Is Wally free to use?

Wally offers both free and paid plans. Please visit our pricing page for current information.

What content does Wally index?

Wally indexes your published posts and pages, along with any PDF attachments. It does not index draft content, comments, or other content types unless specifically configured.

How often should I index my content?

You can either manually index your content whenever you make significant changes, or enable the auto-sync feature to automatically index new or updated content.

Can I customize the appearance of the search widget?

Yes, you can customize the appearance of the search widget from your Wally dashboard at trywally.ai.

What data does Wally collect from my visitors?

Wally collects search conversations to provide responses. It does not collect personal information from your visitors unless they explicitly provide it in the search. See our Privacy Policy for more details.

Is Wally GDPR compliant?

Yes, Wally is designed with privacy in mind and is GDPR compliant. We provide tools to help you comply with GDPR requirements, including data export and deletion capabilities.
